title: High-Temporal-Resolution Measurements of the Impacts of Ionizing Radiation on Superconducting Qubits
summary: We measure the effect of ionizing radiation on superconducting qubits with a timing resolution of 1 $μs$ using microwave kinetic inductance detectors (MKIDs) fabricated on the same substrate. We observe no correlation between two-level system (TLS) scrambling events and ionizing radiation events detected with the MKIDs, suggesting TLS scrambling events may not arise from ionizing radiation and instead the previously reported apparent correlation may be due to events without sufficient energy to trigger our MKIDs.
